item.title: Jensen Huang built Nvidia into a $4 trillion AI giant but owned less than 4% of it, leaving him without the super-voting power to protect his CEO role
item.description: Huang was the largest individual shareholder, but couldn’t decide the makeup of the board on his own due to the company’s share structure.

item.title: Standard Chartered profit jumps 46% as CEO bets on a fragmenting global economy: ‘An advantage for us’
item.description: Pre-tax profit rose 27% to $2.25 billion as wealth fees climbed 26%, and CEO Bill Winters is betting on tokenized money in Hong Kong.
